data_sources.environment: REAL PUBLIC ENVIRONMENT DATA - NOT IN-SITU ZHUANGHE OBSERVATION

WINTER_POPULATION_COHORT.selection_rule: All 120 predeclared V0.7 winter timestamps crossed with three predeclared simulated geometries; policy outcomes never used. 360 historical replay scenarios, not real missions.

BASELINE_CONSERVATIVE.policy_definition: INTERNAL SIMULATION BASELINE: dynamic residual high risk after departure -> return
BASELINE_CONSERVATIVE.action_constraint_status: COMMON SPEED/HEADING CONSTRAINTS ACROSS ALL POLICIES

LOCAL_ADJUST_ONLY.policy_definition: INTERNAL SIMULATION BASELINE: dynamic executed local maneuver; failure -> return
LOCAL_ADJUST_ONLY.action_constraint_status: COMMON SPEED/HEADING CONSTRAINTS ACROSS ALL POLICIES

HANHAI_MISSION_CONTINUITY.policy_definition: INTERNAL SIMULATION BASELINE: executed adjust -> reroute -> safe hold -> return last
HANHAI_MISSION_CONTINUITY.action_constraint_status: COMMON SPEED/HEADING CONSTRAINTS ACROSS ALL POLICIES

blocker_report.assignment_rule: ONE PRIMARY BLOCKER PER SCENARIO; COUNTS SUM TO COHORT N

DECISION_RELEVANT_COHORT.selection_rule: Before any policy replay: initial residual-high OR direct-route current-snapshot high-risk; fixed direct route, fixed nominal vessel state, real public environment only.
